clue.text: Expect to hold son in the middle

indicators.note: to hold means one word wraps around the other, keeping it inside

parts.note: to expect something is to wait for it

explanation.surface: A pregnant woman expects to be carrying a boy in her belly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to hold' puts S inside WAIT. 'Expect' reads like pregnancy, which makes 'the middle' feel like the belly; it is simply the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The narrow part of the body between ribs and hips is its midsection.

clue.text: Ideal place to observe a tug

definitions.text: Ideal place to observe a tug

parts.words: Ideal place to observe a tug
parts.note: a tug is a boat that tows, so it is a 'tower'; a lookout post lets you watch it

explanation.definitionFit: A tall lookout structure is built for keeping guard over the surroundings.

clue.text: Cinerama display not open to the public

indicators.note: display means the letters are set out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A widescreen film showing is private.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin legal phrase for proceedings held privately, in a judge's chambers.

clue.text: Painstaking search for house in depressed area

indicators.note: in means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a trough is a low-lying hollow

explanation.surface: A careful hunt for a home in a run-down district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depressed area' suggests economic decline, but it is a physical dip; 'search for' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Being careful and complete in every detail is to be meticulous.

clue.text: Divine food

parts.note: read as delicious grub, it is also literally the fare eaten by the gods of Olympus

explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the gods' food conferred immortality; the word is also used of any delicious dish.

clue.text: It's from Austria that one gets scent

indicators.note: from means the letters of the first word are taken out of the country's name, leaving a jumble to sort

explanation.surface: A perfume comes from Austria.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' strips the letters I, T, S out of AUSTRIA; what is left, A U R A, is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A subtle smell or emanation surrounding something is a distinctive air.

clue.text: Model again, then rest

definitions.meaning: to sit for an artist once more
a state of calm and relaxation

explanation.surface: A sitter poses once more and then takes a break.
explanation.definitionFit: Split as two parts it means to pose a second time; whole, it means tranquillity.

clue.text: She's a refuse-collector in south Africa

indicators.note: in means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: A is an abbreviation for Africa
a bin collects rubbish

explanation.surface: A woman works as a dustman in South Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts A BIN between S and A; 'south Africa' looks like the country.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's given name, so it can stand for a female person.

clue.text: Nurse a mother initially hired to…

parts.note: MA is a familiar word for mother

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A mother first takes on a nanny to look after things.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis runs on into 10 down; 'to' is a link. An amah is a nursemaid in East or South Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: A wet nurse or nanny in parts of Asia goes by this name.

clue.text: Manage to exist, despite being idle

definitions.meaning: to keep going in a minimal way, just getting by
an engine running slowly while out of gear

explanation.surface: Someone scrapes a living even though they do no work.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to function at a low level and, of an engine, to run without engaging gears.

clue.text: Rebuke Scotsman tucking into a meal

indicators.note: tucking into means one piece is placed inside another, as food is tucked away

parts.note: a dish is a meal or course
MON is a Scots form of 'man', so a crossword Scotsman

explanation.surface: A Scotsman is scolded for greedily eating a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucking into' suggests a greedy eater, but here it is a container signal: the Scotsman goes inside the meal, after the A.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprimand someone is to tell them off firmly.

clue.text: …guard the obstreperous child

indicators.note: obstreperous means unruly, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Continuing 7 down, the nurse was employed to watch over an unruly youngster.
explanation.definitionFit: A female offspring is somebody's child.

clue.text: A male twosome indebted for retirement place

annotationWithheld.why: A male twosome indebted for retirement place (7): AMM goes in HOCK, but 'indebted' must give both HOCK (from 'in hock') and the containment 'in', one word doing two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: A male twosome indebted for retirement place

clue.text: Locker-holders make critical calls

definitions.meaning: things that hold the keys for locks
important telephone calls, split as an adjective and a verb

explanation.surface: Those who manage lockers have to make important decisions.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun it means hoops for carrying keys; split as two words it means makes important phone calls.

clue.text: Once over in Germany, worker becomes high-spirited

parts.note: EX means former, what something once was
über is the German word for over
the worker ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: Someone who was once working in Germany is now full of joy.
explanation.definitionFit: Being full of energy and cheerfulness is to be in high spirits.

clue.text: Humour an engineer by displaying moderation

parts.note: temper and humour both mean mood
CE is the abbreviation for civil engineer

explanation.surface: Indulge a technician by showing restraint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Humour' looks like a verb (to indulge) but is the noun mood; 'by displaying' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-restraint, especially in drinking, is moderate behaviour.

clue.text: To survive crisis, Theresa threw Tom out

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A politician named Theresa saved herself by ejecting a colleague called Tom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'threw Tom out' reads as an action, but 'threw' is fodder and only 'out' signals the anagram of all three names.
explanation.definitionFit: To come through a difficult period intact is to ride out a tempest, idiomatically.

clue.text: Little money in posted deposit

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: sent means posted, as a letter
a dime is a small US coin

explanation.surface: A small sum is placed in a mailed bank deposit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deposit' reads as a bank payment but is matter settling at the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Matter that settles at the bottom of a liquid is a deposit.

clue.text: Late notice

parts.note: reads as a warning given too late, but late means dead: an announcement of a death

explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper piece reporting someone's death, often with a short biography.

clue.text: Roger and I corrupted us banker

indicators.note: corrupted means these letters are spoilt and rearranged

explanation.surface: Roger and the speaker were bribed by an American bank employee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banker' is crossword shorthand for a river, something that has banks; this one forms part of the US-Mexico border.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is a thing with banks, and this major river flows through the United States.

clue.text: Stampede over marsh-growing plant

parts.note: on can mean over, as in resting on top of
a rush is a plant growing in wet ground

explanation.surface: Animals bolt over a boggy plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden forward surge of people or animals is a headlong charge.

clue.text: I had to enter arena on horseback

indicators.note: to enter means one piece goes inside another

parts.note: a ring is an arena, as in circus or boxing
I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: Someone recalls having entered the show ring on a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Mounted on a horse means being astride it.

clue.text: Party list includes number one

indicators.note: includes means one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a roster is a list of names on duty
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: The guest list for a party has the most important person on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Party' is a verb here: to revel noisily.
explanation.definitionFit: To celebrate boisterously is to make merry, which is what this verb means.

clue.text: Old garden viewed one Sunday in march

indicators.note: in means these letters are placed within the other word

parts.note: a parade is a march
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A historic garden is seen on a Sunday during the month of March.
explanation.walkthrough: 'march' looks like the month but is a procession; 'viewed' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Eden, the first garden of Genesis, is the original earthly bliss.

clue.text: Top-class fruit

definitions.meaning: excellent, desirable, as in a choice job

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a desirable prize and a sweet stone fruit.

clue.text: Spot some of Zaire's pygmies

indicators.note: some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Catch sight of a few members of Central Africa's forest peoples.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch sight of something is to notice it.

clue.text: Iran and Suez resolved to make him overlord

indicators.note: resolved suggests something worked out anew, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dispute between Iran and the Suez region was settled by installing a ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: A feudal lord to whom vassals owe allegiance is a sovereign above them.

clue.text: Many a house in Georgia and new York is wooden

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many
GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
Y is a short form for York

explanation.surface: Many homes in Georgia and New York are built of timber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' and 'and' are links; the pieces simply follow in order.
explanation.definitionFit: A reddish-brown tropical timber; furniture made of it is described by its name, as wooden.

clue.text: Healthy meals may include it

indicators.note: may include means the answer sits within the words before it

explanation.surface: A herb is a common ingredient in nutritious cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: The whole clue describes a culinary herb that might go into wholesome dishes.
